reviewer: Pickle: hand eczema epidemiology, winter aggravation, wet-work and fissure rates, glycerin concentration-response, petrolatum TEWL, urea concentration thresholds, fragrance patch-test rates, official Korean/UK/US dry-skin guidance, O'Keeffe's label and ranking claim, and Coupang/Kakao product terms
method: Reviewed the draft against 24 sources on 2026-11-12. Hand eczema burden: the Annals of Dermatology 2016;28(3):335 multicentre Korean study surveyed 1,000 adults online and found a 31.2% lifetime prevalence, and among 913 patients asked about season 33.6% named winter as the worst (spring 12.2%, summer 16.8%, autumn 7.0%, no season 30.4%); the same study places lesions on fingers in 39.1% and palms in 31.2%, health care providers at 22.9% and housewives at 19.5%, and disinfectant as the most suspected causative agent at 22.3%. The KCI-indexed Korean review of 189 hand eczema patients (Yun et al.) gives a mean duration of 37.3 months and wet work as the leading aggravating factor at 24.3%, with patch tests positive in 20 of 24 tested patients. The RWEAL multicountry retrospective (J Dermatolog Treat 2025) reports fingertip involvement in 41.6% and fissures in 46.7% of moderate-to-severe chronic hand eczema at the last visit. Glycerin: the concentration-response table (5% 0.86, 10% 1.44, 20% 1.74, 40% 1.80 over two weeks on human dry skin in winter, Bissett et al. 1984 as reproduced in Thau, J Cosmet Sci 53:229-236) is quoted as the source of the 'no doubling' argument, together with the same review's statements that 20-45% glycerin is recognised as an OTC skin protectant and that undiluted glycerin can dehydrate skin by osmosis while 80-100% approaches petrolatum. Petrolatum: the MDedge dermatology review states petrolatum reduces TEWL by 98% versus 20-30% for other oils; the article uses only the occlusive role and tells readers to apply it on damp skin, which matches the MSKCC dry-skin handout (20-second hand washing, fragrance-free moisturiser on slightly damp skin, petroleum jelly plus cotton gloves at night, stop alcohol and fragrance products, report discharge, fever, pain, redness or warmth). Hand washing: Williams et al., Br J Dermatol 2010;162:1088-92, 132 volunteers washing 15 times daily for two weeks, found HECSI worsening only in the soap-only arm (p=0.003) with no change in moisturiser arms, and TEWL reduction in three of five products at day 7. Urea: Dall'Oglio et al., Int J Clin Pract 2020;74:e13815 places 15-30% as medium concentration and states keratolysis is better obtained above 30%; the CCID 2022 study of a 30% urea cream in 20 women with hand eczema over 28 days reports lower TEWL and redness and higher hydration with no adverse reactions while conceding the formulation confound; the JAAD 2005 abstract covers 5% urea with sodium lactate and glycerin in 31 healthy and 20 patient volunteers over two weeks with improved roughness and TEWL protection; the article therefore assigns 5-10% to fissured painful skin, 10-30% to hyperkeratotic palms and 30-40% to thick heel skin, and warns that salicylic acid combinations can sting fissures (JAAD 2025 pedal fissure comparison). Allantoin: Cosmetics Info/CIR records FDA OTC skin-protectant use at 0.5-2% and cosmetic use up to 2%, and the JAAD 2017 abstract notes that healing mechanisms rest mostly on animal and in-vitro work, so the article treats it as a soothing adjunct only. Fragrance and alcohol: Heydorn et al., Contact Dermatitis 2003;48:275 patch-tested 658 hand eczema patients and found 10.2% positive to at least one selected fragrance; the 2026 Korean multicentre patch-test study (Contact Dermatitis, 2,271 patients at 15 hospitals, 2019-2024) reports 57.1% with at least one positive reaction, nickel 29.0%, cobalt 18.2%, chromium 8.2%, fragrance mix I rising with age and hand involvement linked to MBT, colophonium, 4-tert-butylphenol formaldehyde resin and thimerosal. Official Korean guidance: the KDCA winter cold-wave health guide (updated 2026-06-02) sets indoor humidity at 40-50% and says dry indoor air dries skin and eyes; Seoul Asan Medical Center's dermatology column states that amount and frequency of moisturiser matter more than the product type, that cream beats lotion in winter, and cites a 2022 study where twice-daily moisturiser for two weeks improved erythema, scaling and fissures; the Money Today interview with Prof. Kim Hyun-jung of Gachon Gil Medical Center recommends a 15% glycerol plus petrolatum occlusive combination, application within three minutes of washing, two to three times a day, lukewarm water for under ten minutes and 40-60% indoor humidity, and lists thyroid disease, diabetes and kidney disease as possible causes of generalised dryness. Products: all four Coupang items were opened in the browser on 2026-11-12 and their prices, review counts, ratings and delivery dates read from the pages - 오킵스 워킹핸즈 96g jar at 9,020 won after 30% off 13,000 won with 3,163 reviews and 4.5 rating arriving 11/13 dawn; 카밀 핸드 앤 네일 크림 클래식 100 mL x3 at 6,810 won after 68% off 21,600 won (2,270 won each, 227 won per 10 mL) with 51,956 reviews and 5.0 arriving 11/13 dawn; 뉴트로지나 인텐스 리페어 시카 56g at 6,620 won after 16% off 7,900 won with 12,851 reviews and 4.5 arriving the day after tomorrow; 익스트림버프 우레아 100000ppm 50 mL at 12,280 won with 1,444 reviews; 바세린 올 퍼포즈 크림 40g at 2,200 won after 51% off 4,500 won with 1,274 reviews. Two brief claims were corrected rather than repeated: O'Keeffe's 'No. 1 in America' is a Nielsen 52-week sales claim (period ending 9/10/2022 per the Amazon listing), not a firefighter-endorsed ranking, and the brand's jar formula ingredient list (O'Keeffe's Canada) is the only basis for the allantoin mention, with the article noting that Coupang's 96 g listing does not print a full ingredient list; Neutrogena's 40-45% glycerin belongs to the UK/French Norwegian Formula, while the Korean 56 g cica version lists water, glycerin, cetearyl alcohol, panthenol, allantoin, fragrance and centella extract without a percentage, so the article states that gap explicitly. Kakao Gift: the curator dashboard was reachable after a saved-login sign-in, and a new link (gift-link.kakao.com/c/XmytwFuI) was minted for 부케가르니 나드 핸드크림 & 퍼퓸 립밤 세트 4종 at 15,000 won with 749 gift reviews, 4.0 rating, free shipping, gift wrapping and expected commission of 1,350 won; the article carries the required curator disclosure. The affiliate deep links were built from the product pageKey/itemId/vendorItemId read on those pages. Numbers that first collapsed into artifacts in the gate because of tilde ranges were rewritten as 'X에서 Y' and no tilde remains in the body. Category kept at living per the brief (the rhinitis and ventilation guides in this cluster also sit in living). Gate score 100/100, dist check 0 failures.
